That keeps Vref near 0.9 V with about 1300 ppm/C. A beta multiplier with weak-inversion NMOS (K=8, I≈0.5 uA) stacks only one PMOS Vsg plus about 0.1 V, which fits 1.62 V even with |Vth|p≈1.1 V. Three branches draw about 1.6 uA, or roughly 3.2 uW at 1.98 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "Wn":  (10.0, 4.0, 30.0),     # NMOS core width (um), deep weak inversion
    "Ln":  (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "Wp":  (4.0, 2.0, 12.0),      # PMOS mirror width
    "Lp":  (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "K":   (8, 4, 16),            # M2/M1 multiplicity
    "R1":  (140e3, 80e3, 300e3),  # sets PTAT current
    "R2":  (660e3, 400e3, 1.0e6), # PTAT voltage at output
    "mq":  (8, 2, 16),            # output PNP multiplicity (lowers Veb, steepens its slope)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    Wn, Ln, Wp, Lp = p["Wn"], p["Ln"], p["Wp"], p["Lp"]
    K = int(round(p["K"])); mq = int(round(p["mq"]))
    R1, R2 = p["R1"], p["R2"]

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # --- beta multiplier (subthreshold NMOS, PMOS mirror diode on right branch)
    n.M("M1", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)            # NMOS diode
    n.M("M2", "pb", "nb", "s2", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln, m=K)         # K x, source degenerated
    n.R("R1", "s2", "vss", R1)
    n.M("M3", "nb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)             # mirror -> left branch
    n.M("M4", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)             # PMOS diode
    # --- output branch: Vref = Veb + I*R2
    n.M("M5", "vref", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=mq)
    # --- start-up: weak pull-up on node a; once nb rises, Ms2 pulls a low and Ms3 turns off
    n.M("Ms1a", "x1", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Ms1b", "x2", "vss", "x1", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Ms1c", "a", "vss", "x2", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Ms2", "a", "nb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 10.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms3", "pb", "a", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)           # pulls PMOS gate low in zero state
    n.C("Cs", "a", "vss", 0.2e-12)

    # --- first-order predictions
    nsub = 1.35
    I = nsub * UT * math.log(K) / R1
    vptat = I * R2
    Ie = I / mq
    veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / max(Ie, 1e-12))
    vref = veb + vptat
    dveb = (veb - 1.2) / 300.0 - 0.25e-3          # V/C
    dptat = vptat / 300.0
    dv = abs(dveb + dptat) * 165.0
    tc = dv / vref / 165.0 * 1e6
    Itot = 3 * I + 0.08e-6
    power = 1.8 * Itot
    # line regulation from PMOS output conductance into R2 + re
    try:
        op = lut.op('p', Wp, Lp, 0.9, 0.9)
        rout = 1.0 / max(op["gds"], 1e-15)
    except Exception:
        rout = 50e6
    rlow = R2 + UT / max(Ie, 1e-12) / 1.0
    line_reg = rlow / (rout + rlow) * 0.5
    psrr = -20 * math.log10(max(line_reg, 1e-6))
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "power": power,
               "line_reg": line_reg, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
